title: Uka Arusti Abismo tuqitwa
intro: Mä cuento paciencia ukat Divino ukan jan tukuskir khuyapayasiñapat Quran ukan uñsti. Mä yatiyiriw mä jachʼa markar khitapjjäna, ukampis markapajj janiw uka ewjjtʼarojj istʼapkänti, cheqa yatichäwinaksa janiw munapkänti. Frustración ukanx aka almax sarxänwa — ukakipkarakiw jach’a qutan yant’ata ukat ch’amaka manqharuw manq’antatäna. Ch’amaka purakatxa, mä alt’at chuyman achikt’asiwiw sartasïna, ukat khuyapayasir Diosax jaysäna. ¿Khitis aka almax mayjt’ayat uñstawayi, jupan jaqinakapax patak waranqa jila iyawsirinakaruw tukupxaspa?
clues: Mä jach’a markar yatiyirit khithatätwa, ukan jakirinakax iyawsäwi thakhit jithiqtapxatayna.
Markajarojj walja kutiw cheqa yatichäwir jawsayäta, ukampis jupanakajj sawkasipjjewa, yatiyatajarus janiw istʼapkänti.
Janïr permiso churatäkipanjja, jan waltʼayataw jupanakat sarjjayäta, ukat jachʼa qotaruw sarjjayäta.
Mä jach’a thayaw sartawayi, ukat nayax qutaruw jaquntawayitu — ukatx mä jach’a quta uywaw taqpach manq’antawayitu.

Ch’amaka capanakan — qutan manqhapa, lurat jaqin purakapa, ukat quta manqhankir manqhan — akham sasaw arnaqasta: ‘Janiw kuna diosas utjkiti, jumat sipansa; jach'a kankañax Jumataki; Nayajj jan wali luririnaka taypinkäyätwa’ sasa.
Allah jupax manqhat qhispiyawayitu, ukat kutt’ankta ukhax patak waranq jila jaqinakajax chiqa yatichäwinak katuqawayapxitu.

identity.label: ¿Khitis nayajja?
options: Yunus profeta (Jonás) .
Musa profeta (Moises) jilatajj .
Ibrahim (Abraham) profetax 1999 maranwa uñstawayi.
Zakariyya (Zacarías) profetax .
Idris profeta (Enoc) jilatajj .

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Mä jach’a quta uywamp manq’antatäña
Mä tirano ukat magonakapamp uñkatasiña
Mä colerat reyin nina nakhaskir ninar jaquntatäña
Mä yuqall wawat kusiskañ yatiyäwinak istʼasa, chuymankipstata ukat jan chʼamanïkasa
Mä markar jan waltʼayir uma jalsumpi tʼunjatätap uñjasa

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Lamar quta manqhankir jach’a quta uywan purakapa
Mä qullan uta, qullunakamp muyuntat mä jan ch’uxña valle
Mä nina nakhaskir nina, ukax thaya ukat sumankañ tukuyata
Mä jach’a jardinax jawiranakan jawirani ukat ch’amakaniwa
Mä jachʼa arcajj mä qollu pʼeqeruw samartʼäna
location.answer: Lamar quta manqhankir jach’a quta uywan purakapa

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Chʼamakat qhespiyatäña; walja jaqinakaw iyawsapxäna
Nina nakhaskir ninat qhespiyatäjjänwa, nina nakhantat ninajj thayaruw tukuwayjjäna
Mä chʼamani markan pʼeqtʼiriparuw tuküna ukat tʼaqhesiñat qhespiyarakïna
Mä wawarux chuymankipstatäxänwa, walja maranak mayisiñat qhipatxa
Jach’a yatiñampi, mä reino, ukat thayanakaru ukat jinninakar apnaqañapataki

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
